2026-10-21 00:38:17.141612 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-10-21 00:38:17.141631 | controller |
2026-10-21 00:38:17.141658 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-21 00:38:17.141685 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-21 00:38:17.141702 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-21 00:38:17.141718 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-21 00:38:17.141734 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-21 00:38:17.141750 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
